name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person or organisation as a square cell (Base UI Avatar): the photo rises in from the bottom keyline, initials hold the cell while it loads or after it fails, status as its floor keyline (a line shape per kind, never over the face); AvatarGroup joins avatars on shared seams with a +N count cell.
whenToUse: Use it to show a person or organisation as a square cell, alone or as a group with an overflow count. For a status label use Status or Badge.

parts.name: Avatar
parts.description: A person or organisation as a square cell (Base UI Avatar). The photo fills the cell; while it loads or after it fails, the initials hold the cell in the UI voice. There is no radius in the language, so an avatar is never a circle; with the cut off or on it is the same square (an avatar is a cell, never cut). Given `name` (and `src`), it renders its image and initials itself. Pass children (AvatarImage, AvatarFallback) to compose them instead.

props.name: decorative
props.description: The name is already printed beside the avatar (a list row, a header): hide it from assistive technology so the name isn't read twice.

props.name: fallback
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Overrides the initials, e.g. a two-letter org code or a 16px glyph.

props.name: fallbackDelay
props.description: Base UI: wait this long before showing the initials, so a fast image never flashes them. Default 0.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 1px keyline. cell: a square filling the width of a square-ish cell of an enclosing frame (a hover card's header); it draws no edge. In a list row use a control avatar in the media cell.

props.name: name
props.description: The person or organisation. Names the avatar (role="img") and gives the initials.

props.name: size
props.description: sm 24 · md 32 (default; a list row) · lg 40 · xl 56 (a profile header). Ignored with layout="cell".

props.name: src
props.description: Photo or logo. While it loads, and if it fails, the initials show: never a broken image.

props.name: status
props.description: Status on the avatar's floor: its bottom keyline becomes a signal line, never drawn over the face. Each kind has its own line shape (active solid, away dashed, attention red with a red frame, done double, offline none and a grayscale photo), so it survives grayscale and forced colours. Its words join the accessible name.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Words for the status (default by kind: active, away, needs attention, done, offline).

parts.name: AvatarFallback
parts.description: What holds the cell while the image loads or after it fails (Base UI Avatar.Fallback): the avatar's initials unless given children. Hidden from assistive technology: the avatar carries the name.

parts.name: AvatarGroup
parts.description: Several avatars as cells of one keyline frame, sharing seams (C1: related parts touch). Not a stack of overlapping circles: every face stays whole. With `max`, the overflow becomes one count cell. For a count that opens the full list, leave out `max` and compose AvatarGroupCount with a PopoverTrigger.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: Words for the count cell. Default (n) => `${n} more`.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group, e.g. "Assignees". The visible names and the hidden count are read after it.

props.name: max
props.description: Show at most this many cells; the rest fold into a count cell (+N) that takes the last place.

props.name: total
props.description: Everyone in the group, when more exist than the children passed (a server count).

parts.name: AvatarGroupCount
parts.description: The overflow cell (+N), tabular. Pass `render={<button type="button" />}` (or put it in a trigger's `render`) when pressing it should show everyone.

parts.name: AvatarImage
parts.description: The photo or logo (Base UI Avatar.Image). It shows once loaded; until then, or if it fails, the fallback holds the cell. Decorative: the avatar carries the name.
